audit.reasoning: The deciding quotation is verbatim in the held PL-560 text at the stated appendix/pages. The classification 'undetermined' rests on the best (indeed only) stress-bearing description of Puragi: de Vries's 2004 survey appendix, which marks stress on a 209-item list but states no rule, and the marked stresses visibly vary in position (initial, second, third, fourth syllable), consistent with the record's prule. Glottolog lists zero grammars/sketches/phonologies for Puragi (MED = this wordlist); the other held survey (Berry & Berry 1987) and the newly fetched sources Voorhoeve 1975 ('Stress and pitch are not indicated') are silent.
